tagline: Pick a bit. Feel the room.
about: Jasmeet Singh, better known as Jimmy Oye, is a stand-up comedian out of Chandigarh–Mohali. His bits bounce between hostel life, Punjabi English chaos, city tours, and club-night crowd energy.
He plays rooms across North India and keeps the jokes close to real life. For show queries, reach his booking contact.
